subject: general
question: An article is sold for Rs. 303.60 after offering three successive discounts of 25%, 8% and x% on its marked price of Rs. 500. If the same article is sold after giving a single discount of (33 + x )%, then its selling price (in Rs.) will be:
solution:
Given : 

An article is sold for Rs.303.60 after successive discounts of 25%, 8% and x%.

The marked price of the article = Rs. 500

Concept used :

Marked price × (100 - a)/(100) × (100 - b)/(100) = selling price 

where a and b are discount%

Calculations :

According to the question

500 × (100 - 25)/(100) × (100 - 8)/(100) × (100 - x)/(100) = 303.60

⇒ 500 × 3/4 × 23/25 × (100 - x)/(100) = 303.60

⇒ 15 × 23 × (100 - x) = 30360

⇒ (100 - x) = 88

x = 12%

New discount = 33 + 12 = 45%

SP = 500 × 55/100 = 275

**The answer is 275.**
